headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Analysis
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis to detect potential security risks and outdated packages, ensuring a safer installation process. Implement dynamic binding.gyp command expansion checks for native modules, providing immediate feedback on any potential issues. Optimize the user interface to display detailed risk assessments in an intuitive manner.
actions: Integrate real-time dependency scanning tools like DeepInfer to identify security vulnerabilities and outdated packages before installation.
Develop a dynamic binding.gyp command expansion checker that alerts users to any potential risks associated with native module installations.
Redesign the user interface to present risk assessments in a clear, actionable format, allowing users to make informed decisions during the install process.
